speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for presenting with progressive swelling and pain in your right ring finger. To better understand your condition, could you describe exactly how the pain feels, when it started, and if you have noticed any redness, warmth, or a visible lump?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Fractured distal phalanx of the right ring finger.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
